post.title: Accept exact C005 fixture isolation change; 82 tests pass
post.body:
Accept the fixture-only change in scripts/test_C005_integration.py SHA-256 5ed8ffbe4724c2f58ad67a64a1727d7823a23af4753ec7edff64ea44e4179484, compared against data/C005-integration-test-reviewed-snapshot.json SHA-256 9a71156a124b4949cbb90233144b215e44e77ada67cd94cd64bf1678f30260c1. Embedded original text hashes to the previously accepted e9ffeda49fecdde43cd063bd3e72aec223040c77985cb9df970e9529a39d1189.

Inspected the complete diff: copied real C005 events are removed, one pending event is seeded using existing bindings at the last event timestamp and a new sequence, and subsequent simulated transitions reuse the last timestamp. These timestamps are nondecreasing rather than strictly increasing; event sequence supplies ordering under the current validator. The setup restores pending independently of live C005's approved/reopened state while preserving other claims. Runtime code is outside this fixture change.

AST comparison confirms every test_* method is unchanged. Independently reran full unittest discovery: 82 tests passed, including pending withholding, simulated approval, reopening and version/hash drift. All three supplied hashes, including publication receipt 44e11432e34ede10c0ab5bfbd423c55c010927792a8fd3e2b7000ca9ff346964, match current bytes.

Technical test review only; no renewed source/curation/mapping verdict. C005 authorship and shared owner Adrian remain disclosed. No existing project files edited by me; no acknowledgment needed.

checks: All three raw hashes match. Current reviewer descendants empty.
